prompts.sakuradente:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: single original PipaKlub creature concept, full-body transparent game illustration.
Create SAKURADENTE, a magnificent compact saber-toothed tiger Pipamon whose anatomy IS a living kite. Not an ordinary furry animal carrying a kite. Four sturdy feline legs, a broad confident face, exactly two long ivory folded-paper saber canines, small rounded ears, amber eyes. Warm ivory and apricot paper body, dark plum tiger stripes shaped like brush-cut paper, a few pink blossom markings. A low angular folded-paper kite sail grows structurally from the shoulders and spine, with slender bamboo spars and visible cream string knots. Its silhouette should be recognizably saber-toothed tiger before anything else.
Signature feature: an anatomically attached KITE TAIL MADE OF CHERRY BLOSSOM PETALS. A visible continuous rose-pink braided thread exits a tied knot at the rump and sweeps in one broad graceful S curve; overlapping large folded sakura-petal paper pennants are visibly threaded and tied along it, tapering into smaller petals. One attached continuous rabiola, never a disconnected cloud of floating petals, never a second mammalian tail. The petal tail must be completely visible with generous space and no tangles over the face or paws.
Art direction: established PipaKlub living-paper 2D game illustration between crisp cel-shaded anime creature illustration and refined pixel-art sensibility. Dark clean slightly angular outlines, expressive face, deliberate paper facets, 3-4 flat shadow tones per material, crisp shape clusters, readable at thumbnail scale. Match the handmade bamboo-and-paper visual vocabulary; no photoreal fur, no glossy plastic 3D, no painterly cinematic lighting, no generic jewelry/crown/bell/crystal.
Pose: full body three-quarter view facing right, proud crouching ready stance, relaxed closed mouth accommodating the two saber canines; balanced anatomy and all four paws clear. One character only, centered with 12 percent transparent breathing room around every extremity including petal tail. Genuine transparent RGBA background, opaque ivory paper. No scene, ground, cast floor shadow, labels, text, sheet grid, palette circles, watermark, duplicates or extra views. Premium production concept with simplified dominant forms.
prompts.bicoatrevido:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: single original PipaKlub creature concept, full-body transparent game illustration.
Create BICOATREVIDO, an original PLATYPUS Pipamon with cheeky Brazilian neighborhood street-rascal attitude, mischievous and charismatic. Anatomically a living handmade kite, not a regular animal dressed in a costume. A compact squat pear-shaped teal-blue folded-paper body, broad warm ochre duck bill with a sly sideways grin, alert copper-orange eyes and one eyebrow raised, exactly two short arms with webbed hands and two stocky webbed feet, a wide flat BEAVER-LIKE PLATYPUS TAIL built as a patchwork kite paddle with visible light bamboo cross-spars and cream string knots. A short connected strip-paper rabiola tied at the end of that paddle tail.
Signature character details: a small asymmetric backwards cap made from folded rust-orange kite paper; a diagonal knotted utility cord carrying one small wooden kite-line spool at his hip; simple patched kite-paper shoulder panels suggest a cropped street jacket without obscuring the platypus silhouette. Crooked posture, one hand resting on the spool, the other hand gesturing playfully with an open webbed palm. His trickster identity is carried by expression, cap, movement, and handmade paper repairs. No human ethnic caricature, no weapon, no drugs, no money or stolen objects.
Art direction: established PipaKlub living-paper 2D game illustration between crisp cel-shaded anime creature illustration and refined pixel-art sensibility. Dark clean angular contours, large expressive eyes, broad flat color planes, deliberate paper creases, 3-4 flat shadow tones per material, crisp shape clusters rather than noise. Limited teal/petroleum, ochre bill, rust-orange, cream cord, dark navy outlines. Species silhouette and kite construction both unmistakable. No photoreal fur, glossy 3D, cinematic painting, ornate gold jewelry, bells, crowns or crystals.
Pose: a single full-body three-quarter character facing left, confident jaunty stance, entire broad paddle tail offset behind the body and readable, no clipping or hidden endpoints. Plenty of 12 percent transparent margin around cap, hands, feet and tail. Genuine transparent RGBA background, opaque character paper, no scene, ground, floor shadow, text, labels, palette, sheet grid, duplicate poses or watermark. Premium concept art with clean game-readable shapes.
